event.location_text: MALACCA STRAIT Medan Anchorage, Indonesia Indonesia 03° 53.90' N 098° 48.00' E

sources.title: Piracy monthly report October 2024
sources.text: While at anchor, the duty AB noticed someone hiding in the hawse pipe and sighted a small boat near to the ship anchor chain. The duty AB immediately reported the sighting to the Officer of the Watch (OOW) and shouted at the boat man to deter the perpetrators. The duty AB retreated to the accommodation block and updated OOW. He subsequently spotted another perpetrator at the starboard winch holding a machete. The OOW raised ship alarm and announced via the PA system of the armed perpetrators onboard. The perpetrators then escaped from the ship. A search was conducted onboard. No suspicious person was discovered. All crew members were safe and some unsecured items
